crossRefs.note: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’
For those who are such don’t serve our Lord, Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering…
through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,
But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about…
forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of…
Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.

people.name: Caphtor
people.line: Island home of the Philistines; visited by Paul

translations.web: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
translations.bsb: As one of their own prophets has said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”
translations.kjv: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
translations.asv: One of themselves, a prophet of their own, said, Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, idle gluttons.
